states.claim: pos is advanced to lpos, the start of the next line.
When no complete line is present, llen bytes from pos are copied into gopherState->buf at offset gopherState->len.
When gopherState->len is nonzero, gopherState->buf bytes are copied into line and the current line bytes are appended after them.
When gopherState->len is zero, llen bytes from pos are copied into line.
line is null-terminated at index llen + 1.
tline is set to point to the line buffer.
name is set to point to the character after the first character of tline.
selector is set to the first TAB character in tline, or NULL if none exists.
When selector is non-NULL, the TAB at selector is replaced with a null terminator and selector is advanced past it.
host is set to the first TAB character in selector, or NULL if none exists.
When host is non-NULL, the TAB at host is replaced with a null terminator and host is advanced past it.
port is set to the first TAB character in host, or NULL if none exists.
When port is non-NULL, port[0] is set to ':' and the port string is terminated at the next TAB, carriage return, or newline.
When port is non-NULL and the port string is exactly "0", port[0] is set to null.
escaped_selector is set to a newly allocated string containing the RFC1738-escaped form of selector.
escaped_selector is freed.
line is cleared to all zero bytes when the line begins with '.', when selector is NULL, or when host is NULL.
gopherState->HTML_header_added is set to 1 after the HTML header is added.
gopherState->HTML_pre is set to 1 when the HTML header is added.
